key_insight: Masked diffusion language model RL should optimize both token generation and which positions are remasked, because generation is a two-stage action process rather than token prediction alone.
engineering_relevance: For practical LLM training, the paper suggests a more faithful policy-gradient objective that can improve reasoning and code generation in diffusion-based generators.
method: Formulate MDLM generation as a two-stage MDP: token placement and remasking decisions.
Decompose the policy gradient into a token term and a masking term.
Optimize both terms jointly instead of approximating likelihood with token predictions only.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art benchmark results, including 87.1% on GSM8K and 53.4% on MBPP.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurately modeling the remasking policy, which may add implementation complexity and instability compared with token-only approximations.
paper_title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
